quests.title: Onion Johnny
quests.summary: Learn three Breton words and carry a string of Roscoff onions to Plymouth, as the Johnnies did.

steps.text: Learn demat and kenavo from the Old Johnny by the Maison des Johnnies.
Learn trugarez from the Diwan teacher.
Take the onion string on the ferry to Plymouth and give it to the Millbay ferry hand, then return to Gwenola.

quests.reward: A triskell pin (a Fae charm), kouign-amann and standing with Kin Abroad.
